tools.name: cartrelay_search
tools.description: Discover source-backed product previews for a shopper in Canada or the United States. Shopify is primary; CJ, Impact and Awin advertiser feeds participate only when enabled and approved. Direct merchant products participate in CA/CAD only when their verified merchant explicitly authorizes authentica

tools.name: cartrelay_detail
tools.description: Resolve an exact source product or variant and inspect supplied options. CJ/Impact/Awin feed records do not prove retailer variant selection. Some source fields are inferred; never infer ingredients or verified pack size.

tools.name: cartrelay_price_stock
tools.description: Look up current selected references. Availability is a source signal, not reserved stock or final checkout confirmation. CJ/Impact/Awin advertiser-feed status is separate from unverified live retailer stock.

tools.name: cartrelay_cart_create
tools.description: Build a signed ten-minute intent of exact selections/requested quantities and return its human review URL. Agent delegation is not consent. No merchant cart, reserved stock or price guarantee; CJ/Impact/Awin product links do not prefill variants or quantities.

tools.name: cartrelay_checkout_handoff
tools.description: Requires independently recorded originating-shopper approval of this exact token, not just approval:true. Re-check price, variant, merchant and link identity; return retailer links only when unchanged/resolved. Never purchases or pays.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
